doc: Target sidecar of the I18 Go frontend (frozen at the I18 prereg; contract: the docstring of tests_m2/test_extract_go.py). It is the only place the Morph vocabulary of the Go extraction lives: which Go packages are extracted into which document of spec/M2/facts/<stem>.go.extracted.json, where the source tree is found, and the declared semantics of the dependency functions the frontend treats as primitives (each one used becomes a go-prim:<name> assumption of the document). holon/frontends/go/ holds none of these names. Every package of every document is loaded and analyzed in every run, whichever documents are written.

github.com/morph-l2/go-ethereum/common.B.text: BytesToHash(b) is the 32-byte array holding b right-aligned (common/types.go: SetBytes crops b to its last 32 bytes, then copies it to h[32-len(b):]); for len(b) == 32 element k is b[k].

github.com/morph-l2/go-ethereum/crypto.K.text: Keccak256Hash(data...) is the keccak-256 digest of the concatenated arguments: an opaque HASH sink; it reads its arguments and retains none of them.

(github.com/morph-l2/go-ethereum/common..text: Hash.Bytes() has a value receiver and returns h[:], a 32-byte slice over the receiver's copy: a fresh backing array whose element k is h[k].
